Home.title: OpenInvites
Home.tagline: An open source, self-hostable service for event invitations.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email for OpenInvites
verifyEmail.body:
Hi {name},

Open the link below to confirm this is your email address. It is valid for one hour.

{url}

If you did not sign up for OpenInvites, you can ignore this message.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your OpenInvites password
resetPassword.body:
Hi {name},

Open the link below to choose a new password. It is valid for one hour.

{url}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message and your password stays as it is.

hostInvitation.subject: Your host invitation for OpenInvites
hostInvitation.body:
Hello,

Here is your host invitation for OpenInvites. Open the link below to create your host account and start making event pages.

{url}

The link works for one account and expires in {days} days. If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message.

body.replied:
{name} replied to {title}: {status}{plusOnes, plural, =0 {} one {, bringing one more person} other {, bringing # more people}}.

Your guest list:
{url}

To stop these emails, untick “Email the hosts when a guest replies” in the event’s settings. That stops them for every host of the event.
body.changed:
{name}’s RSVP to {title} is now {status}{plusOnes, plural, =0 {} one {, bringing one more person} other {, bringing # more people}}.

Your guest list:
{url}

To stop these emails, untick “Email the hosts when a guest replies” in the event’s settings. That stops them for every host of the event.
body.removed:
{name}’s RSVP to {title} was removed. It said {status}{plusOnes, plural, =0 {} one {, bringing one more person} other {, bringing # more people}}.

Your guest list:
{url}

To stop these emails, untick “Email the hosts when a guest replies” in the event’s settings. That stops them for every host of the event.

manage.publishHint: Publishing makes the event link work for anyone who has it.
manage.duplicateHint: Makes a new draft with the same details, look, questions, settings and picture. Replies, comments and announcements are not copied.
manage.publishedHint: Anyone with the link can open the event page. Edits show up there straight away.
manage.draftHint: Only the hosts can open the link while the event is a draft.
manage.cancelHint: The page stays up with a notice, and no more RSVPs are taken.
manage.cancelText: Guests who open the link will see that it is called off. Your guest list stays, but nobody can reply any more.
manage.cancelledHint: Cancelled. Guests see the notice on the page and cannot reply.
manage.deleteHint: Removes the event and everything guests told you. This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteText: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has replied, so nothing else goes with it. The link stops working.} =1 {One RSVP, and the answers with it, are deleted. The link stops working.} other {# RSVPs, and the answers with them, are deleted. The link stops working.}}
